description_en: Queries the configuration information of a domain name that has been added to WAF protection
description_zh: 查询已添加到WAF防护的域名的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-domain --instance-id waf-cn-7pp26f10000 --domain www.example.com --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86373.html to query all domain names that have been added to WAF protection
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的域名名称。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86373.html查询所有已添加到WAF防护的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

Domain.description_en: The configuration information of the domain name

AccessHeaderMode.description_en:
The method that WAF uses to obtain the originating IP address of the client. Valid values:

0: WAF reads the first value of the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) field in the request header as the client IP address.
1: WAF reads the value of a custom field that you specify in the request header as the client IP address.

This parameter is returned only when IsAccessProduct is set to 1 (indicating that another Layer 7 proxy service is deployed in front of WAF)
AccessHeaderMode.description_zh:
WAF获取客户端真实IP的方式。取值：

0：表示WAF读取请求头中X-Forwarded-For（XFF）字段的第一个值作为客户端IP。
1：表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP。

仅当IsAccessProduct取值为1（表示WAF前有其他七层代理服务）时，返回该参数

AccessHeaders.description_en:
The list of custom fields used to obtain the originating IP address of the client.

This parameter is returned only when AccessHeaderMode is set to 1 (indicating that WAF reads the value of a custom field that you specify in the request header as the client IP address)
AccessHeaders.description_zh:
用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表。

仅当AccessHeaderMode取值为1（表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP）时，返回该参数

items.description_en: The custom field used to obtain the originating IP address of the client
items.description_zh: 用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段

AccessType.description_en:
The Website Config method. Valid values:
waf-cloud-dns: CNAME access.
waf-cloud-native: transparent access
AccessType.description_zh:
域名接入方式。取值：
waf-cloud-dns：表示CNAME接入。
waf-cloud-native：表示透明接入

CloudNativeInstances.description_en:
The configuration list for transparent access.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-native (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the transparent access method)
CloudNativeInstances.description_zh:
透明接入的配置列表。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-native（表示域名使用透明接入方式接入WAF）时，返回该参数

CloudNativeProductName.description_en:
The type of the cloud service instance. Valid values:

SLB: Classic Load Balancer (CLB, formerly SLB) instance.
ECS: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) server.
ALB: Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance
CloudNativeProductName.description_zh:
云产品实例的类型。取值：

SLB：表示传统型负载均衡CLB（原SLB）实例。
ECS：表示云服务器ECS实例。
ALB：表示应用型负载均衡ALB实例

IPAddressList.description_en: The list of public IP addresses of the cloud service instance
IPAddressList.description_zh: 云产品实例的公网IP地址列表

items.description_en: The public IP address of the cloud service instance
items.description_zh: 云产品实例的公网IP地址

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the cloud service instance

ProtocolPortConfigs.description_en: The list of protocol and port configurations

Protocol.description_en:
The protocol type. Valid values:
http: HTTP.
https: HTTPS
Protocol.description_zh:
协议类型。取值：
http：表示HTTP协议。
https：表示HTTPS协议

RedirectionTypeName.description_en:
The type of the traffic redirection port. Valid values:

SLB-L4: redirects traffic from the Layer 4 listener port of a Classic Load Balancer (CLB, formerly SLB) instance to WAF for protection.
SLB-L7: redirects traffic from the Layer 7 listener port of a CLB instance to WAF for protection.
ECS: redirects traffic from the listener port of an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) server to WAF for protection.
ALB: redirects traffic from the HTTP or HTTPS listener port of an Application Load Balancer (ALB) instance to WAF for protection
RedirectionTypeName.description_zh:
引流端口的类型。取值：

SLB-L4：表示从传统型负载均衡CLB（原SLB）实例的四层监听端口引流到WAF进行防护。
SLB-L7：表示从传统型负载均衡CLB（原SLB）实例的七层监听端口引流到WAF进行防护。
ECS：表示从云服务器ECS实例的监听端口引流到WAF进行防护。
ALB：表示从应用型负载均衡ALB实例的HTTP、HTTPS监听端口引流到WAF进行防护

ClusterType.description_en:
The cluster type of the WAF instance. Valid values:

0: physical cluster.
1: virtual cluster, which is a WAF exclusive cluster.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method)
ClusterType.description_zh:
WAF实例对应的集群类型。取值：

0：表示物理集群。
1：表示虚拟集群，即WAF独享集群。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）时，返回该参数

Cname.description_en:
The CNAME assigned by WAF to the domain name.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method)
Cname.description_zh:
WAF为域名分配的CNAME地址。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）时，返回该参数

ConnectionTime.description_en:
The connection timeout period of the WAF cluster. Unit: seconds.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method)
ConnectionTime.description_zh:
WAF集群的连接超时时长。单位：秒。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）时，返回该参数

Http2Port.description_en:
The list of HTTP 2.0 ports.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method) and HttpsPort is not empty (indicating that the domain name uses HTTPS)
Http2Port.description_zh:
HTTP 2.0端口列表。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）且HttpsPort取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，返回该参数

HttpPort.description_en:
The list of HTTP ports.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method)
HttpPort.description_zh:
HTTP端口列表。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）时，返回该参数

HttpToUserIp.description_en:
Indicates whether the HTTP back-to-origin feature is enabled. Valid values:

0: disabled.
1: enabled.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method) and HttpsPort is not empty (indicating that the domain name uses HTTPS)
HttpToUserIp.description_zh:
是否开启了HTTP回源功能。取值：

0：表示未开启。
1：表示已开启。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）且HttpsPort取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，返回该参数

HttpsPort.description_en:
The list of HTTPS ports.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method)
HttpsPort.description_zh:
HTTPS端口列表。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）时，返回该参数

HttpsRedirect.description_en:
Indicates whether HTTPS forced redirect is enabled. Valid values:

0: disabled.
1: enabled.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method) and HttpsPort is not empty (indicating that the domain name uses HTTPS)
HttpsRedirect.description_zh:
是否开启了HTTPS强制跳转。取值：

0：表示未开启。
1：表示已开启。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）且HttpsPort取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，返回该参数

IpFollowStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the IPv4/IPv6 back-to-origin protocol follow feature is enabled. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method)
IpFollowStatus.description_zh:
是否开启了IPv4/IPv6回源协议跟随。取值：
0：表示未开启。
1：表示已开启。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）时，返回该参数

IsAccessProduct.description_en:
Indicates whether another Layer 7 proxy (such as Anti-DDoS Pro or CDN) is deployed in front of WAF, meaning whether client traffic passes through another Layer 7 proxy before reaching WAF. Valid values:

0: no.
1: yes
IsAccessProduct.description_zh:
域名在WAF前是否配置有其他七层代理（例如高防、CDN等），即客户端访问流量到WAF前是否有经过其他七层代理转发。取值：

0：表示否。
1：表示是

Keepalive.description_en:
Indicates whether persistent connections are enabled. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false: disabled
Keepalive.description_zh:
是否保持长连接。取值：

true：表示保持长连接。

false：表示不保持长连接

KeepaliveRequests.description_en:
The number of requests that reuse persistent connections. Valid values: 60 to 1000.

The number of persistent connections to reuse after persistent connections are enabled
KeepaliveRequests.description_zh:
复用长连接的请求个数。取值范围：60~1000，单位：个。

开启长连接后，复用多少个长连接

KeepaliveTimeout.description_en:
The idle timeout period for persistent connections. Valid values: 1 to 60. Default value: 15. Unit: seconds.

The idle duration after which a reused persistent connection is released
KeepaliveTimeout.description_zh:
空闲长连接超时时间，取值范围：1~60，默认15，单位：秒。

复用的长连接空闲多少长后释放

LoadBalancing.description_en:
The load balancing algorithm used for back-to-origin. Valid values:

0: IP Hash.
1: round-robin.
2: Least Time.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method)
LoadBalancing.description_zh:
回源时采用的负载均衡算法。取值：

0：表示IP Hash算法。
1：表示轮询算法。
2：表示Least Time算法。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）时，返回该参数

LogHeaders.description_en:
The traffic tag fields and values of the domain name, which are used to mark traffic processed by WAF.

This parameter is returned only when the traffic tag feature is enabled for the domain name
LogHeaders.description_zh:
域名的流量标记字段和值，用于标记经过WAF处理的流量。

仅当域名开启了流量标记功能时，返回该参数

k.description_en: The name of the traffic tag field

v.description_en: The value of the traffic tag field

ReadTime.description_en:
The read connection timeout period of the WAF cluster. Unit: seconds.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method)
ReadTime.description_zh:
WAF集群的读连接超时时长。单位：秒。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）时，返回该参数

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs

Retry.description_en:
Indicates whether WAF retries when back-to-origin fails. Valid values:

true: retries.

false: does not retry
Retry.description_zh:
WAF回源失败时，是否重试。取值：

true：表示重试。

false：表示不重试

SniHost.description_en:
The custom value of the SNI extension field. An empty value indicates that no custom SNI value is set. By default, the value of the Host field in the request header is used as the value of the SNI extension field.

This parameter is returned only when SniStatus is set to 1 (indicating that back-to-origin SNI is enabled)
SniHost.description_zh:
SNI扩展字段的自定义值。取值为空表示未自定义SNI值，默认使用请求头中Host字段的值作为SNI扩展字段的值。

仅在SniStatus取值为1（表示开启SNI回源）时，返回该参数

SniStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether back-to-origin Server Name Indication (SNI) is enabled. When back-to-origin SNI is enabled, WAF forwards client requests to the origin server and specifies the host to access through the SNI extension field (Server Name Indicator extension) during the TLS handshake with the origin server, and then establishes an HTTPS connection with the specified host. Valid values:

0: disabled.
1: enabled.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added by using the CNAME method) and HttpsPort is not empty (indicating that the domain name uses HTTPS)
SniStatus.description_zh:
是否开启了回源SNI。回源SNI表示WAF转发客户端请求到源站服务器，在与源站进行TLS握手时，通过SNI扩展字段（Server Name Indicator extension）指定要访问的主机，并与该主机建立HTTPS连接。取值：

0：表示未开启。
1：表示已开启。

仅在AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式）且HttpsPort取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，返回该参数

SourceIps.description_en:
The addresses of the origin server.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method)
SourceIps.description_zh:
源站服务器地址。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）时，返回该参数

items.description_en: The address of the origin server

Version.description_en: The version of the current domain name configuration

WriteTime.description_en:
The write connection timeout period of the WAF cluster. Unit: seconds.

This parameter is returned only when AccessType is set to waf-cloud-dns (indicating that the domain name is added to WAF by using the CNAME method)
WriteTime.description_zh:
WAF集群的写连接超时时长。单位：秒。

仅当AccessType取值为waf-cloud-dns（表示域名使用CNAME接入方式接入WAF）时，返回该参数
